remarks: Welcome to Penthouse 27F at Park Tower Stamford! This spacious, fully renovated 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home features an open kitchen and an expansive living area with stunning views of the Long Island Sound and the New York City skyline from the floor to ceiling windows. The floor to ceiling windows are equipped with remote-controlled blinds for effortless convenience. Beautiful engineered hardwood flooring flows throughout, enhancing the modern aesthetic. The kitchen boasts new luxury modern designed cabinets, sleek quartz countertops, a waterfall island with a wine cooler, and luxury appliances. The master bath offers a serene retreat with a luxurious shower, a soothing jacuzzi tub, a stylish double sink vanity, and a convenient towel warmer for ultimate relaxation. Every detail has been infused with a European signature adding a touch of elegance to create a cohesive living space that stands out.   Park Tower offers unparalleled amenities, including concierge service, 24-hour security, a fitness center, party room, resident lounge, billiards room, indoor pool, sauna, screening room, and a rooftop terrace. Enjoy convenient commuting with a shuttle service to and from the train station. With easy access to restaurants, shops, entertainment, and I-95, this penthouse truly exemplifies luxury living!
